## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling and SPY/TLT in RECOVERY (SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION) provide mixed confirmations while HYG/LQD shows credit stress ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD (Level 0.7505) → flat | NEUTRAL with HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND. Energy strength supporting risk: BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION and Dollar Strength (Level: 28.0800 | 1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.04%) → flat | CORRECTION; Stocks vs Bonds ratio RECOVERY (9.3686 | 1W: +0.40% | 1M: -0.11%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and Brent BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing 1W strength via sector breadth (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%). Weakness in cyclicals/discretionary: XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; Tech mixed with XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US flat-to-firm: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND while Emerging Markets outperforms on the week: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation healthy: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; small-cap IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) in RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Broad commodity bid led by oil: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY; gold taking short-term profit: GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy clearly strong: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; natural gas also firm: UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Energy (XLE and BNO both ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: Breadth is narrow (4/11) with several 1W vs 1M mismatches across commodities and themes (GLD, WEAT, SKYY) — MINOR divergence overall, suppressing a strong directional call.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Neutral tactical posture: favor XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; monitor TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION for yield-driven re-pricing.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; Materials/Commodities if commodity momentum continues (BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Industrials — XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Brent/Oil BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Wheat WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION and Gold GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION on short-term profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 17.72 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD 0.7505 (credit health) → flat | NEUTRAL; Tech vs Financials ratio XLK/XLF 3.2234 (rotation pivot); SPY/TLT 9.3686 (RECOVERY) to watch for confirmation of risk tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX falling but credit stress signals mixed. Energy (XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) and EM/crypto (EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND; IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow breadth and credit stress (HYG/LQD level 0.7505) plus multiple 1W/1M mismatches to monitor.
